findings.issue: TOCTOU: both seed writes overwrite their destination by default. If a concurrent refresh or snapshot restore creates domestic.json or international.json after the absence checks, the synthetic seed replaces real data, contradicting the documented no-overwrite guarantee. Use exclusive creation for both files and fail closed on EEXIST.

summary: Fixed one medium-severity TOCTOU defect: fixture seeding now preserves concurrently published snapshots and fails closed using exclusive writes. Both regression cases failed before the fix; the Git Bash validation command now passes 845 Vitest tests, 5 Python tests, typecheck/build, and the existing operating-state checks. The fix is committed locally; CI and Preview validation of the new commit remain for the driver.
